sources.title: ❤ 🎶 [SEASON 16 NEW ] MASTER MID Seraphine! SEASON - THE SONG OF DEATH 🎶🎤

passive.name: Stage Presence
passive.text: Every third basic spell will cast twice from Seraphine. Additionally, casting spells near allies grants her bonus magic damage and range on her next basic attack.

spells.name: High Note
spells.text: Seraphine deals damage in an area.

spells.name: Surround Sound
spells.text: Seraphine Shields and Hastes nearby allies. If she is already Shielded she will Heal nearby allies as well.

spells.name: Beat Drop
spells.text: Seraphine deals damage and impairs the movement of enemies in a line.

spells.name: Encore
spells.text: Seraphine deals damage and charms enemies hit, refreshing the range with every allied or enemy champion hit.

damage.value: Seraphine deals magic damage through High Note poke and can burst with an Echoed High Note.

archetype.value: Seraphine is a backline mage who damages enemies while shielding and healing allies.

axis.value: Seraphine plays lane through poke and repeated harassment to gain priority.

winCondition.value: Seraphine turns picks into objectives and uses Encore to affect as many champions as possible in team fights.

spikes.why: Seraphine’s magic penetration makes her High Note poke stronger, especially against squishier targets.
Seraphine can follow crowd control with E and R for a burst of damage.
Seraphine casts it twice, increasing its impact.

bait.why: After Seraphine spends W, its 22-second cooldown is a window without its shield and haste.
After Seraphine spends R, its long cooldown is a window without its charm.

mistakes.value: Seraphine wastes potential in team fights when she neglects her Echo mechanic.
Seraphine misses W’s conditional heal if she casts it while not already shielded.
